svg.title: Road representation — editable base map
svg.desc: A base map reconstructed from road-representation.png with three editable layers: ground colors; roads and gray building footprints with 2-pixel borders; and street names plus map attribution text. Street names follow the roads in the top text layer, with a 5-pixel white halo. Graph nodes, graph edges and the graph frame are omitted. Roads and buildings partially hidden by those annotations are reconstructed from their visible surroundings.
